decisive_items: Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region
Fundus examination: Few yellow spots present, no pigmentary degeneration
response.rationale: Choroideremia is more likely due to specific OCT patterns and fundus examination findings, despite some atypical features for both candidates

rejected.why: Lack of pigmentary degeneration on fundus examination is atypical for Retinitis Pigmentosa
